title: Max Dupain

paragraphs.text: Today, I'll talk about Max Dupain, a photographer who shaped modern Australian photography. His career spanned several decades, and his images became some of the most recognized in the country.
Dupain played a key role in photography of art, and he helped to develop a distinct Australian style.

Early in his career, he worked on portraits using lighting and composition to highlight each subject. In nineteen thirty-four, he established a studio, allowing him to refine his techniques and expand his professional work.

Later, he shifted to documentary photography, capturing moments of daily life across Australia. His work in fashion photography led him to collaborate with designers and produce stylish images for magazines.
Over time, he also worked in industrial photography, photographing factories, bridges, and large infrastructure projects.
Among his famous images, The Sunbaker stands out for its strong triangle composition, creating a powerful visual effect.
Beyond artistic photography, he also photographed industries, including the meat sector, focusing on food production and supply chains.
